deviations.reason: The spec (docs/api.yaml, the .svc/{table} 200 response) types every OData row with the docs' demo 'simple' form and marks its age/name required. Central builds each row from the requested form's own field list (generateDataFrame / submissionToOData), so a row carries that form's fields (here head_name, household_size, ...), never a fixed age.
Same spec defect as the 'age' entry: 'name' is a field of the docs' demo form, not of every form. Central's row columns come from the requested form's fields.

deviations.message: {the MIME type of the attachment file itself}
deviations.reason: The spec's 200 media-type key is a prose placeholder ('{the MIME type of the attachment file itself}', docs/api.yaml L10652), not a media type. Central serves the attachment's stored content type (here image/png): the route calls blobResponse(), which sets Content-Type to blob.contentType.
